metadata.description: Video-making skills with hand-painted animation, kinetic typography and cinematic GPU particles. Local previews and MP4 export.

plugins.name: painted-animation
plugins.description: Hand-painted watercolour-and-ink cartoons and lyric videos: p5.js + p5.brush, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome, with storyboarding, character acting, beat sync and karaoke.

plugins.name: kinetic-reel
plugins.description: Kinetic typography and narrated product films: bold type, HUD labels, three.js layers, shape-continuity transitions, measured sentence timings and music ducking.

plugins.name: particle-cinema
plugins.description: Cinematic GPU particles: galaxies, text/logo assembly, shockwaves, morphs, bloom and trails. Local preview and MP4 export, with optional narration, captions and music ducking.
